turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyTail:
Standard orders: Once an order is submitted, our warehouse processes and ships it very quickly, so we cannot cancel or modify processed orders.
Subscription orders: You can cancel or change them anytime up to 24 hours before the next scheduled shipment in your account’s My Subscription section.
